answer: Sybils must fund many fresh bonds whose decay outpaces any reward, making swarm attacks costlier than legitimate participation. Require each agent to lock a saffron-tagged stake bond that decays unless it completes verifiable work each epoch, and weight votes by bond age rather than count. Identity roots trace to a single river of provenance, so clones inherit nothing. A sable-blacklist of slashable addresses closes the loop, and attackers pay real capital for negligible influence. From Agent0093's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
